reason: Provides a model-facing read_image tool that sends workspace images to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint and returns answers about their contents.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供 read_image 工具，将工作区中的图片发送到配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉接口并返回图像内容问答。
summaries.en: Provides agents with a read_image tool that sends workspace images to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint for image-content questions.

capabilities: reads image files from the workspace or configured allowed directories
uploads image data to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
uses an API key from an environment variable for each request
